items.text: The firmware upgrade on EDGE-RTR-LON-02 (CHG-8841) caused a planned interface bounce on Gi0/0/2, which dropped the three BGP sessions. The 17-second gap between interface going down and BGP alert firing is consistent with SNMP trap processing latency in EPNM — not a BGP timer event. This is an expected side effect of planned maintenance activity.
